chat.title: Ask For Help
chat.subtitle: Here to help with your farm
chat.welcome: Hello! Ask me about crop advice, yield predictions, or using FasalSathi.
chat.replyPrediction: The estimate uses crop, weather, soil, rainfall, and field details. It is a model-based estimate, not a guarantee.
chat.replyYield: Consider local soil and weather conditions, plan irrigation carefully, and use balanced nutrients. Consult a local agriculture expert for field-specific advice.
chat.replyLanguage: The chat follows the website language. Change it with the language selector, and the chat labels and replies will update.
chat.replySupport: I can help explain FasalSathi, crop yield estimates, and the farm information used for predictions.
chat.fallback: I can help with FasalSathi, crop predictions, and general farm planning. Try one of the suggested questions.
